summary: Bound FP8 shared-expert dequantization to scale-row-aligned chunks. Exact output equivalence and a 49.05% allocator-peak reduction were measured on the assigned gfx950; the original two-node GB10 model load was unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: 10 CPU tests: exact chunked-versus-single-chunk packed output, grouped input, partial final scale-row block, invalid MXFP4 column boundary, packing layout, and numerical round trips.
On AMD MI355X, 4096x8192 packed weights and scales were byte-identical; peak GPU allocation fell from 2690648576 to 1371015680 bytes (49.05%).
Formatting tool availability; ruff is not installed in the prepared interpreter.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-3ddd0ba32212/gpu_conversion.txt records byte equality and allocator peaks on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950).

remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GB10/SM12x hardware, second node, b12x preview runtime, or DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp weights were available. Full model startup, unified host-memory peak, b12x execution, and multi-node behavior remain unverified. No native source was changed.
